text:
julia_sales: quick heads-up — Prospect (MedAtlas) tried sending one huge POST with ~40MB of docs inlined and got HTTP 413 during their demo. Need a one-paragraph response + a tiny curl they can run now.

omar_eng: 413 = edge rejection (proxy limit). Do we know payload shape? base64 in JSON?

julia_sales: yes, PDFs base64'd inside a JSON array. They thought single-call UX was easiest.

harper_support: That will bloat size ~33% on top of original. Our proxy default is 4MB. Two quick paths: gzip the request (Content-Encoding: gzip) or presign-upload + notify endpoint.

omar_eng: For fastest demo patch: gzip client-side and send as text/plain with Content-Encoding: gzip. Server decompresses before tokenization. Still warn about token cost — compression only helps transport, not billing.

julia_sales: please paste a one-liner curl I can DM them.

harper_support: minimal gzip curl: 
```
echo -n "$(cat combined_text.txt)" | gzip -c | curl -X POST \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \ 
  -H 'Content-Type: text/plain' \ 
  -H 'Content-Encoding: gzip' \ 
  --data-binary @- 'https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate?model=rwd-4x&max_tokens=1024'
```
Add note: do NOT base64 binary in JSON.

omar_eng: If they insist on raw file upload in one UX, presign flow is safer (upload then ingest). I can paste presign steps too.

julia_sales: yes please, presign too (short).

harper_support: presign pattern (3 steps):
1) POST /presign -> returns upload_url and key
2) PUT upload_url with file
3) POST /ingest {"key":"<s3_key>","model":"rwd-4x","max_tokens":1024} -> we fetch and process.
Minimal cURL chain: 
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/presign -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"filename":"bundle.zip"}'
# client: PUT to returned upload_url
curl -X PUT "<upload_url>" --upload-file bundle.zip
# then notify ingest
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/ingest -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"source_key":"<s3_key>","model":"rwd-4x"}'
```

sre_bot: Note: if client retries immediately after 413 they might hit 429s. Advise no auto-retry on 413 and exponential backoff for 429.

omar_eng: If the customer wants guaranteed demo success we can temporarily raise the body limit for their IP for the demo window (requires SOC). Ops can do a 1-hour exception.

julia_sales: Demo in 18m. Can we get a 1-hour exception?

ops_bot: ticket-11023 opened -> request proxy body-size bump to 50MB for IP 203.0.113.77 for 60 minutes. Approval pending (SOC). ETA ~15m.

harper_support: I'll DM both the gzip curl and the presign steps now. Also include a one-line note about token cost: "Compressing transport doesn't reduce tokens — trim docs or use retrieval to cut cost."

julia_sales: perfect. If the SOC approves, please let me know so I can tell them to retry original flow; otherwise they'll use gzip. Share session id med-042 in case eng needs logs.

sre_bot: update: ticket-11023 approved -> change applied. Temporary client_max_body_size increased for IP 203.0.113.77 to 50MB for 60m. Audit id AUD-9210.

julia_sales: amazing, sending instructions + telling them demo is green. will report outcome after the call. :thumbsup:
